In the 'Matches' dataset, there seems to be some relation between goals_scored/opponent_rank and goals_conceded/opponent_rank. We investigate this further below by fitting a Normal Linear Model to the data with opponent_rank as the response:

```{r lm}

model1 = lm(opponent_rank~goals_scored+goals_conceded, data=matches)

summary(model1)


```

We observe that both goals_scored and goals_conceded are significant to the 5% level.
Now we plot residuals and check the Q-Q plot:

```{r plots}

plot(model1$fitted, rstudent(model1), xlab='Fitted values', ylab='Studentized residuals')
abline(h=0, lwd=2)

qqnorm(rstudent(model1), main=NULL)
qqline(rstudent(model1), lwd=2)

```

```{r box-cox}

library(MASS)
boxcox(model1, lambda=seq(-30, 30, by=0.01))

#selecting lambda=0.5:
model1_bc = lm(Weight^(0.5)~Height, data=matches)
summary(model1_bc)



```
